title: Check a device-approval address
responsibility: Accepts a plain secure device-approval URL and rejects other addresses.

inputs.name: hostedAddress.value
inputs.description: The candidate address to check; when it is undefined, the function parses an empty string. It passes only for HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1], with no username, password, query, or fragment and a pathname of /native/ followed by 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

outputs.name: hostedAddress
outputs.description: The URL parser's normalized href when the candidate passes the scheme, plain-address, and approval-path checks; otherwise the result is null. Missing or malformed values, credentials, a query, a fragment, or any other path return null, and this function makes no network request.
